question: What time zone is used for all dates and times in the English guide?
answer: All dates and times in this guide use Thailand time (Asia/Bangkok).

question: How can users switch the website language between Thai and English?
answer: The website can be switched between Thai and English with the TH/EN button.

question: In what year was SaiSai Glassware founded and what products are its bottles made for?
answer: SaiSai Glassware was founded in 2015 (B.E. 2558) and makes glass bottles for beverages, honey and cosmetics.

question: Where is the SaiSai Glassware factory located?
answer: The factory is located in a test industrial estate in Bang Phli, Samut Prakan, Thailand (fictitious address).

question: What is the total daily production capacity of the factory and how many forming lines does it have?
answer: Total production capacity is about 120,000 bottles per day on 3 forming lines.

question: Which quality and food-packaging certifications has the factory achieved and since what years?
answer: The factory is certified to ISO 9001 (since 2018) and GMP for food packaging (since 2020).

question: Does SaiSai sell to retail consumers or only to business customers (B2B)?
answer: SaiSai sells to business customers (B2B) only; one company account can have several users.

question: Which orders, claims, and quotations can each user account view?
answer: Each user can only see orders, claims and quotations of their own company.

question: What type of glass are all bottles made of, and are they lead-free and recyclable?
answer: All bottles are soda-lime glass (Type III), lead-free and 100% recyclable.

question: Approximately what percentage of recycled cullet does the glass contain?
answer: The glass contains about 30% recycled cullet.

question: Which bottle models and colours are recommended for health drinks and juices?
answer: Health drinks and juices: B-250 and B-500 in clear or amber.

question: For energy drinks and concentrated health shots, what bottle sizes and glass shade does the guide suggest?
answer: Energy drinks and health shots: B-100 and B-150 in amber.

question: Which bottle is most recommended for honey, and which one is recommended for family size?
answer: Honey: B-250 amber is the most recommended bottle; B-500 amber for family size.

question: Which bottle models are recommended for cosmetics such as serum, toner, and essential oils?
answer: Cosmetics (serum, toner, essential oils): B-100 and B-150.

question: What type of neck finish does the B-500 use for metal twist caps?
answer: The B-500 uses a 43 mm lug finish for metal twist caps (1/4 turn).

question: Why can the B-100 and B-150 models use the same caps?
answer: The B-100 and B-150 share the same 28 mm neck, so they can use the same caps.

question: Does SaiSai sell bottle caps to customers?
answer: SaiSai does not sell caps; customers source caps that match the neck finish.

question: What percentage of UV light between 300 and 400 nm does amber glass block?
answer: Amber glass blocks more than 90% of UV light between 300 and 400 nm.

question: What minimum thermal shock temperature difference can all bottles withstand?
answer: All bottles withstand a thermal shock of at least 42 °C.

question: Up to what temperature is hot filling allowed, and to what temperature must bottles be pre-heated?
answer: Hot filling is allowed up to 85 °C if bottles are pre-heated to at least 45 °C.

question: In what quantity increments must bottle orders be placed?
answer: Quantities must be in steps of 100 bottles.

question: What is the maximum number of bottles per order in the system?
answer: The maximum is 200,000 bottles per order; larger orders must be arranged with sales.

question: Within what time window is an identical order from the same company treated as a duplicate?
answer: An identical order from the same company within 10 minutes is treated as a duplicate.

question: Can an order skip steps when moving forward through the status flow?
answer: An order moves forward one step at a time and cannot skip steps.

question: What printing method and firing temperature are used for logo printing on bottles?
answer: Logos are printed by ceramic screen printing and fired at about 600 °C, so the print becomes part of the glass.

question: What is the minimum number of bottles per order required for logo printing?
answer: Logo printing requires at least 5,000 bottles per order.

question: What is the logo printing fee per bottle across all models and colours?
answer: The logo printing fee is THB 0.80 per bottle for every model and colour.

question: How many print positions and colours per position are covered by the flat logo fee?
answer: The flat fee covers up to 2 positions (front and back) with up to 2 colours per position.

question: Which artwork file formats are accepted for production, and which are for reference only?
answer: Accepted artwork files are AI (CS6 or later), vector PDF, SVG and EPS; JPG and PNG are reference only.

question: What are the minimum line width and minimum text height for logo artwork?
answer: The minimum line width is 0.3 mm and the minimum text height is 1.5 mm.

question: At which order step is logo artwork approved?
answer: Artwork is approved at step 2 (Spec confirmation); production cannot start before approval.

question: Within how many working days is a digital proof sent, and how many free revisions are included?
answer: A digital proof is sent within 2 working days; 2 revisions are free.

question: How many standard ceramic ink colours are available, and are gold or metallic inks offered?
answer: 8 standard ceramic ink colours are available; gold and metallic inks are not offered.

question: What is the standard lead time for picking up or receiving an order?
answer: The lead time is 14 days: the pickup date must be at least today + 14 days.

question: At which order steps can customers change the pickup date themselves?
answer: Customers can change the pickup date themselves only while the order is at step 1 or 2.

question: What payment terms apply to companies with fewer than 3 shipped orders?
answer: Companies with fewer than 3 shipped orders must pay in full before production (prepay).

question: How many shipped orders are required before a company automatically gets 30-day credit?
answer: After 3 shipped orders, a company gets 30-day credit automatically.

question: How is the credit due date calculated for credit orders?
answer: The credit due date is the shipping date + 30 calendar days.

question: What VAT rate is added to every order and how is it rounded?
answer: VAT 7% is added to every order and rounded half-up to 2 decimals.

question: What is the bank account name, bank, and account number for bank transfers?
answer: Bank transfer: SaiSai Glassware Co., Ltd. · Test Bank · account 000-0-00000-0.

question: For how many days is a quotation valid from its issue date?
answer: A quotation is valid for 7 days from the issue date.

question: How many free sample bottles can a company request per model per month?
answer: Free samples: up to 3 bottles per model per company per month.

question: Within how many days of the shipping date must claims be reported?
answer: Claims must be reported within 7 days of the shipping date (shipping day = day 0).

question: What is the sales phone number and what are the operating hours?
answer: Sales phone: 02-000-0000 (Mon–Fri 08:30–17:00, Thailand time).

question: Where can customers find the complete policy rules if this English booklet only provides an overview?
answer: The Thai-language documents (SS-POLICY, SS-CAT-BOTTLES and others) contain the full details; this guide is a summary.

question: During which stage of the six-step order workflow does the customer sign off on the logo design?
answer: Step 2 Spec confirmation (logo artwork is approved here)

question: If a customer is on prepayment terms, when must their payment be recorded in the workflow?
answer: Step 3 In production (prepaid orders must be paid before this step)

question: Do bulk order discounts reduce the cost of screen printing or truck transport?
answer: Quantity discounts apply to the bottle amount only, not to logo printing or delivery.

question: How should fonts and dimensions be prepared in the vector design file before submitting for printing?
answer: Text must be converted to outlines and artwork must be at 1:1 scale.

question: How does the system handle factory closure days when calculating the soonest available delivery date?
answer: The earliest pickup date skips factory holidays.

question: Does adding a custom logo make the 14-day production schedule longer if the customer approves the proof within three days?
answer: Logo printing does not extend the 14-day lead time if artwork is approved by day 3.

question: How much is the transport fee for shipping 25,000 bottles to a destination 160 kilometres away, and why?
answer: Example: 25,000 bottles delivered 160 km away need 2 trips, so delivery costs THB 3,000.

question: During what days and hours can buyers pick up their goods directly at the plant, and what distance should they enter?
answer: Customers can collect at the factory Monday–Saturday, 08:30–16:30, free of delivery charge (enter 0 km).

question: Can a business buyer settle their invoice using physical cash or a personal cheque?
answer: Cash and personal cheques are not accepted.

question: Through which two channels on the platform can an authenticated buyer generate a formal price quote?
answer: Logged-in customers can request a quotation from the order page or from the chatbot Nong Sai.

question: What is the numbering pattern used for official quotation documents?
answer: Quotation numbers look like QT-0001.

question: How many times can a saved quotation be turned into a confirmed purchase order?
answer: A quotation keeps all price lines as of the issue date and can be converted to an order once.

question: Which validation checks are re-run by the system when a buyer turns a quote into an active order?
answer: When converting, all rules are checked again (14-day lead time, holidays, duplicates).

question: What must a buyer do if their quotation has already passed its seven-day validity period?
answer: Expired quotations cannot be converted; please request a new one.

question: In what exact sequence are item cost, discount, printing fee, freight, and tax combined to reach the grand total?
answer: Order totals are calculated in this order: bottles − discount + logo + delivery = subtotal, then + VAT 7% = total.

question: How much do sample bottles cost, and when does the monthly allowance refresh?
answer: Samples cost THB 0.00 and the quota resets on the first day of each calendar month.

question: Is the monthly limit of three free samples tracked per bottle size model or separately for each glass colour?
answer: The sample quota counts by model, not by colour.

question: How quickly are sample requests dispatched by courier, and do they come with custom logo printing?
answer: Samples are sent by parcel within 5 working days and are not printed with logos.

question: If a consignment is delivered on 12 October 2026, what is the final date to submit a damage claim?
answer: Example: shipped on 12 Oct 2026, claims are accepted until 19 Oct 2026.

question: What code format is mandatory when filing a product claim, and how many numerals follow the prefix?
answer: A claim needs the lot number in the format LOT- followed by 6 digits, e.g. LOT-261001.

question: Where can a customer locate the production batch code when inspecting delivered cartons?
answer: The lot number is printed on the carton side label and on the delivery note, not on the bottle.

question: How many image files must accompany a claim submission, and what are the file format and size limits?
answer: Attach 1 to 5 photos, JPG or PNG, each no larger than 5 MB.

question: When staff turn down a claim request, what text length requirement applies to the explanation?
answer: A rejection always includes a reason of 1–1,000 characters.

question: Will the factory compensate for bottles that crack because the customer filled them above the maximum temperature limit?
answer: Damage caused by hot filling above the limit is not covered.

question: What two forms of compensation are available once a customer's damage claim is approved?
answer: Approved claims receive replacement bottles in the next delivery or a credit note.

question: Does SaiSai arrange international ocean or air freight directly to foreign countries?
answer: SaiSai does not ship overseas; export customers collect at the factory or use a domestic forwarder warehouse.

question: What are the dimensions of the wooden pallets used for packing, and is a pallet deposit charged?
answer: Pallets are 120 × 100 cm wooden pallets; no deposit and no return needed.

question: According to Table 2.1, what model, size, colour, and slug correspond to product code P01?
answer: Product P01 is the B-100 clear bottle (100 ml, slug b100-clear).

question: In the product list table, which bottle model, capacity, glass colour, and slug are assigned to code P07?
answer: Product P07 is the B-250 green bottle (250 ml, slug b250-green).

question: According to the dimensions table, what are the height and diameter of the B-100 bottle?
answer: The B-100 is 98 mm tall and 45 mm in diameter.

question: According to the specifications table, what is the empty weight and neck diameter of the B-250 bottle?
answer: The B-250 weighs 190 g (empty) and has a 38 mm neck.

question: In the bottle dimensions chart, how many grams does an empty B-500 weigh and what is its neck finish size?
answer: The B-500 weighs 320 g (empty) and has a 43 mm neck.

question: From the MOQ table, what is the minimum order quantity for the B-100 bottle?
answer: The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-100 is 2,400 bottles.

question: What is the lowest number of bottles a customer can order for the B-500 model according to the MOQ table?
answer: The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-500 is 800 bottles.

question: According to the print area table, what is the maximum front print area for the B-250 bottle?
answer: The maximum front print area of the B-250 is 60 × 55 mm.

question: What are the width and height dimensions of the front screen-printing zone on a B-500 bottle in the print table?
answer: The maximum front print area of the B-500 is 80 × 90 mm.

question: According to the factory holidays table, which public holiday falls on 23 Oct 2026?
answer: 23 Oct 2026 (Chulalongkorn Day) is a factory holiday and cannot be chosen as a pickup date.

question: According to the delivery table, how many bottles can one truck trip carry?
answer: One truck trip carries up to 20,000 bottles of any model.

question: According to the delivery table, how much does delivery cost per trip for distances over 50 km?
answer: Delivery over 50 km costs THB 1,500 per trip.

question: According to Table 8.1 on export documents, is a Certificate of Analysis (CoA) available and within how many working days?
answer: A Certificate of Analysis (CoA) is provided per lot on request within 2 working days.

question: According to Table 8.1, what is the certificate number and validity date of the food-contact test certificate?
answer: The food-contact test certificate number is FC-2026-014, valid until 31 Jan 2027.

question: According to Table 8.2 (Packing summary), how many B-100 bottles fit in one carton and on one full pallet?
answer: A B-100 carton holds 96 bottles and a full pallet holds 5,760 bottles.

question: In the packing summary table, what is the carton pack count and full pallet quantity for the B-500 model?
answer: A B-500 carton holds 24 bottles and a full pallet holds 1,152 bottles.

question: According to footnote ¹ of Table 2.2, which bottle model is the only one available in green glass?
answer: Green glass is available for the B-250 only (footnote ¹ of Table 2.2).

question: What is the product code and slug for the B-250 clear bottle, and what is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-250 model?
answer: Product P05 is the B-250 clear bottle (250 ml, slug b250-clear). · The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-250 is 1,200 bottles.

question: What is the empty weight and neck diameter of a B-100 bottle, and how many B-100 bottles are held in a carton and a full pallet?
answer: The B-100 weighs 95 g (empty) and has a 28 mm neck. · A B-100 carton holds 96 bottles and a full pallet holds 5,760 bottles.

question: Combining the specifications chart and the packing table, how heavy is an empty B-500 and how many pieces fit per box and pallet?
answer: The B-500 weighs 320 g (empty) and has a 43 mm neck. · A B-500 carton holds 24 bottles and a full pallet holds 1,152 bottles.

question: What is Step 2 of the ordering process called, and why can production not start before this step for logo orders?
answer: Step 2 Spec confirmation (logo artwork is approved here) · Artwork is approved at step 2 (Spec confirmation); production cannot start before approval.

question: Which companies must pay in full before production (prepay), and before which order step must prepaid orders be paid?
answer: Step 3 In production (prepaid orders must be paid before this step) · Companies with fewer than 3 shipped orders must pay in full before production (prepay).

question: Which order step starts the claim period, and within how many days from shipping must claims be reported?
answer: Step 6 Shipped (the 7-day claim period starts) · Claims must be reported within 7 days of the shipping date (shipping day = day 0).

question: What is the delivery fee per trip for distances over 50 km, and how much does a trip to Laem Chabang port (95 km away) cost?
answer: Delivery over 50 km costs THB 1,500 per trip. · Laem Chabang port is about 95 km from the factory, so delivery there costs THB 1,500 per trip.

question: Can a customer order 2,000 B-100 bottles, and what is the required MOQ for the B-100?
answer: The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-100 is 2,400 bottles. · Q: Can I order 2,000 B-100 bottles? · A: No, the MOQ for the B-100 is 2,400.

question: Can a customer print a logo on an order of 3,000 bottles, and what is the minimum bottle quantity required for logo printing?
answer: Logo printing requires at least 5,000 bottles per order. · Q: Can I print a logo on 3,000 bottles? · A: No, logo printing needs at least 5,000 bottles.
